prompt.text:
Implement a framework-free responsive navigation model. Export `NavItem`, `MenuSnapshot`, and class `ResponsiveMenu`. Construction requires a nonempty item list, unique nonempty trimmed IDs and labels, and a nonnegative integer viewport width. Desktop means width greater than 767 and is always expanded; mobile means width at most 767 and initially collapsed. `resize(width)` validates before mutation, forces desktop expanded, and preserves the current mobile expanded state when resizing within mobile. `toggle()` changes state only on mobile and returns whether it changed. `snapshot()` returns all items in insertion order when expanded and an empty item list when collapsed. Inputs and snapshots must be deeply detached from internal state.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
